title: Accepted baseline and continuation policy
summary: Continue from Help Desk v0.1-dev5. Preserve dynamic discovery and authority separation. Current provider evolution is Management Intention Discovery dev9 and Instrumentation Intentions dev2; dev5 remains the accepted runtime-qualified Help Desk baseline until a successor is requalified.
invariants: Do not silently advance the accepted baseline beyond dev5 without fresh ooRexx r13196 qualification.
Do not replace live discovery with a static LLM tool catalogue.
Do not absorb MVS/cloud/network vocabularies or execution authority into the Help Desk.
Preserve NotNotes as the business authority and specialist providers as owners of their own semantics/evidence.
Do not modify separately owned Mini NotNotes/RexxSQL work from the Help Desk lane.
procedure: Start from examples/initech_notnotes_helpdesk_v0.1-dev5 and the accepted archive hash.
Use tools/run_github_source_smoke.sh to verify committed-source closure without the historical customer fixture.
Adopt Management Intention Discovery dev9 only as a generic read-only discovery/resolution seam first.
Use Instrumentation Intentions dev2 through its provider contract, not copied metric vocabulary.
Run the complete Help Desk + NotNotes + specialist qualification before promoting a successor.

provenance.claim: Committed-source consumer smoke and dependency-root policy added 2026-10-29.
